controls.native_baseline: Three SpotBugs diagnostics on the owned unsafe class: two null-related records and one SQL construction record. The corrected class has zero diagnostics.
controls.native_plugin: FindSecBugs adds SQL_INJECTION_JDBC, CWE-89, while preserving every baseline diagnostic. The corrected class remains clean.
controls.owned_witness: The same compiled bytecode throws for the unsafe null dereference and inlines the owned input into SQL; the corrected bytecode returns safely and binds the input separately through a PreparedStatement proxy.

capability_limits: Owned controls only; no scanner-wide precision or arbitrary-code safety claim.
Official Maven prebuilt artifacts are distinguished from catalog revisions. Checksums do not establish signed provenance or source reproducibility.
